- `SourceCodePro-Regular.otf` and `SourceCodePro-LICENSE.txt`: adobe-fonts/source-code-pro at `803b7e23ec97ae58b6232ea76519a76d428ba268`, `OTF/SourceCodePro-Regular.otf` and `LICENSE.md`.
